quote: Member States shall ensure that, when public warning systems regarding imminent or developing major emergencies and disasters are in place, public warnings are transmitted by providers of mobile number-based interpersonal communications services to the end-users concerned
what_it_provides: Binding duty on mobile providers to transmit public warnings.

quote: mobile phone service providers are mandated to send out alerts at regular intervals as required by the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC)
what_it_provides: Operators mandated to send alerts on request of named agencies, to subscribers in the affected area.

quote: a fine of not less than One million pesos (P1,000,000.00) but not more than Ten million pesos (P10,000,000.00) and/or a suspension or revocation of its legislative franchise
what_it_provides: Sanctions on non-compliant corporations.

quote: CMS providers electing in whole not to transmit alerts shall use the following notification language
what_it_provides: Counter-example: participation in Wireless Emergency Alerts is voluntary, but providers must tell subscribers if they do not transmit.

quote: the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) and other relevant agencies
what_it_provides: The law names the agencies whose warnings operators must relay.

quote: The National Centre must act as a repository of. and conduit for. information concerning disasters and disaster management
what_it_provides: A single named national centre for disaster information and its dissemination.

quote: uses CAP to get warnings to the public and emergency management personnel nationwide
what_it_provides: Common Alerting Protocol as a single format shared by all issuers (case presented at the ITU CAP workshop in Mauritius).

quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use
what_it_provides: Human oversight by design for high-risk AI.

quote: Deployers shall assign human oversight to natural persons who have the necessary competence, training and authority, as well as the necessary support
what_it_provides: The public body using the AI must name competent human overseers.

quote: HIEMA lacked procedures to prevent a single person from mistakenly sending a missile alert to Hawaiian public
what_it_provides: What happens without a validation rule: one-person release of a false alert.

quote: the absence of a false alert correction protocol in the ballistic missile alert checklist contributed to HI-EMA’s delay in sending out a correction through WEA/EAS
what_it_provides: Need for a correction protocol (38 minutes to correct).

quote: Develop and memorialize standard operating procedures for responding to false alerts within their jurisdictions
what_it_provides: Recommended procedures for false alerts.

quote: Participating CMS Providers are required to transmit WEA Alert Messages that are issued in the Spanish language or that contain Spanish-language characters
what_it_provides: Language duty beyond the main language.

quote: CB supports messages in any language provided by the warning message originator
what_it_provides: Guidance: multiple languages and accessibility assessed by competent authorities.

quote: Some disabilities (e.g. blindness) may prevent recipients becoming aware of the content of a warning message sent via text
what_it_provides: Accessibility for people with disabilities as an effectiveness criterion.

quote: Deployers of high-risk AI systems shall take appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure they use such systems in accordance with the instructions for use
what_it_provides: Duties of the public body that deploys the AI (basis for allocating responsibility).

quote: Any person who gives false or misleading data or information or willfully or through gross negligence, conceals or falsifies a material fact
what_it_provides: Penalties for false or misleading information in proceedings under the alert law.

quote: the competent authorities may, either sua sponte or at the request of the Prosecutor-General, issue any of the writs stipulated in this Decree-Law
what_it_provides: Power to order correction or blocking of false content (useful comparison for Cameroon).

quote: The levels of accuracy and the relevant accuracy metrics of high-risk AI systems shall be declared in the accompanying instructions of use
what_it_provides: The provider must declare performance levels: the basis for stating validity conditions.

quote: High-risk AI systems shall be accompanied by instructions for use in an appropriate digital format or otherwise that include concise, complete, correct and clear information that is relevant, accessible and comprehensible to deployers
what_it_provides: Instructions for use must let the deployer know the system's limits.

quote: enabling recognition of when systems are not functional within or out of their intended context
what_it_provides: Risk framework: recognise when an AI system is used outside its intended context.

quote: data concerning health or data concerning a natural person's sex life or sexual orientation shall be prohibited
what_it_provides: Health data is a special category with strict exceptions (extension).

quote: a transfer or a set of transfers of personal data to a third country or an in ternational organisation shall take place only on one of the following conditions
what_it_provides: Derogations for transfers abroad (extension).

quote: State Parties shall undertake to prohibit any data collection and processing revealing racial, ethnic and regional origin
what_it_provides: Malabo Convention art. 14: sensitive data, including data on the state of health, is prohibited by default (OCR text; extension).

quote: The data controller shall not transfer personal data to a non-Member State of the African Union unless such a State ensures an adequate
what_it_provides: Malabo Convention: transfers outside the AU need an adequate level of protection, or prior authorisation (OCR text; extension).
